contacts.purpose: Report online financial fraud, including money transferred after being deceived.
contacts.source_note: Official NFCC NSRC information page states victims are encouraged to contact their bank hotline or NSRC via 997.
contacts.display_caution: For an immediate payment concern, contact the bank using the number in its official app or on the back of the bank card.

contacts.purpose: Ask the bank to check a suspicious payment or account activity.
contacts.source_note: The proposal does not identify the user's bank; show only the number published in that bank's official app or on the bank card.

policy: Never invent, infer, or display an unsourced institution phone number.
